journey.title: Diagnose why a profile will not generate
journey.purpose: Refusal is a first-class journey rather than an error case, because this scenario refuses often and for good reasons: an unregistered declaration, a key collision, an infeasible context budget, an exhausted session budget. Each refusal names its cause at the surface where it can be fixed.

steps.intent: Meet the refusal stated inline with its specific cause rather than a dead control
If the cause is registration, see both paths claiming one key and that neither was applied
If the cause is resolution, see both contributing versions and the conflicting metric
